mapper.select: SELECT * FROM batch.workflow_monitoring_policy WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND workflow_definition_id = #{workflowDefinitionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO batch.workflow_monitoring_policy ( tenant_id, workflow_definition_id, soft_runtime_seconds, soft_runtime_severity, start_grace_seconds, start_grace_severity, completion_deadline_local_time, completion_deadline_day_offset, completion_deadline_severity ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{workflowDefinitionId}, #{softRuntimeSeconds}, #{softRuntimeSeverity}, #{startGraceSeconds}, #{startGraceSeverity}, #{completionDeadlineLocalTime}, #{completionDeadlineDayOffset}, #{completionDeadlineSeverity} ) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, workflow_definition_id) DO UPDATE SET soft_runtime_seconds = excluded.soft_runtime_seconds, soft_runtime_severity = excluded.soft_runtime_severity, start_grace_seconds = excluded.start_grace_seconds, start_grace_severity = excluded.start_grace_severity, completion_deadline_local_time = excluded.completion_deadline_local_time, completion_deadline_day_offset = excluded.completion_deadline_day_offset, completion_deadline_severity = excluded.completion_deadline_severity, policy_effective_at = CASE WHEN (batch.workflow_monitoring_policy.soft_runtime_seconds, batch.workflow_monitoring_policy.start_grace_seconds, batch.workflow_monitoring_policy.completion_deadline_local_time, batch.workflow_monitoring_policy.completion_deadline_day_offset) IS DISTINCT FROM (excluded.soft_runtime_seconds, excluded.start_grace_seconds, excluded.completion_deadline_local_time, excluded.completion_deadline_day_offset) THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE batch.workflow_monitoring_policy.policy_effective_at END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
